intake.question: Are there already client records in the target org (e.g. pushed in by ClientWorks or another integration)?
intake.why: If yes, RedTail contacts must be MATCHED to existing Person Accounts / Businesses instead of inserted, or the migration creates duplicates.

intake.question: Will RedTail Accounts (accounts.csv) be migrated as Financial Accounts, or do Financial Accounts arrive from ClientWorks / another integration?
intake.why: First-order scope decision. In ~99% of RT→FSC migrations financial accounts come from the integration, so accounts.csv and every account_* table drop out of scope.
intake.drives: accounts, account_details, account_owners, account_sams, account_types, account_udfs, account_udf_fields, account_udf_field_values

intake.question: Which FSC data model does the target org run — the FinServ__ managed package, FSC-on-Core (Financial Account Management Standard Objects), or both (hybrid)?
intake.why: Every target field API name in steps 4-5 depends on this: FinServ__TaxId__pc, ContactContactRelation + ReciprocalRole vs. PartyRoleRelation, Household record type vs. PartyRelationshipGroup, financial-account structure. Detect via the sobject-reads MCP connector; hybrid orgs must confirm ONE model (see fsc-target-model.md).
intake.default: Detect via MCP connector — most existing FSC orgs are managed package
intake.drives: contacts, contact_memberships, contact_membership_codes, contact_families, contact_family_members, accounts, account_* tables

intake.question: Which key identifies an existing Salesforce record for a RedTail contact?
intake.why: Drives the local Tax-ID match step (Data Loader export of Account Id / LegacyId__c / FinServ__TaxId__pc / business Tax ID, matched locally — Claude sees counts only).
intake.default: Tax ID (FinServ__TaxId__pc for persons; business Tax ID field for businesses)

intake.question: Individuals → Person Account? Businesses / Trusts / ContactAssociations → Business Account? Confirm record type names.
intake.why: Determines the Persons / Businesses split and the RecordTypeName written into load files.

intake.question: Create Households from contact_families? Naming convention? Also create households for persons with no RedTail family?
intake.why: Households are required for FSC rollups; head-of-household flag becomes the primary ACR.
intake.default: Yes — one household per family; one per unfamilied person

intake.question: Migrate keywords as Campaigns with Campaign Members? Which keywords does the client want to keep?
intake.why: Keywords are how RedTail users tag contacts; Campaigns preserve the grouping. Campaign Members must be persons, not businesses.
intake.default: Yes — client selects keywords from the usage-count list

intake.question: Apply the same Campaign / Campaign Member pattern to tags and tag groups?
intake.why: Same structure as keywords; confirm whether tag tables even appear in this extract.

intake.question: Does the client actively use UDFs on contacts or accounts?
intake.why: Each used UDF becomes a custom field decision; unused UDF tables drop out of scope.
intake.drives: contact_udfs, contact_udf_fields, contact_udf_field_values, account_udfs, account_udf_fields, account_udf_field_values

intake.question: Load notes as Salesforce Notes (ContentNote via placeholder object) or as completed Tasks?
intake.why: Changes the load path entirely; note dates cannot be back-stamped on ContentNote so they go into the subject.

intake.question: Migrate activities? Only those related to a contact/business? Rule for Task vs Event?
intake.why: Unrelated / personal activities typically are not migrated; all-day items often should be Tasks.
intake.default: Yes — only activities with a related contact; related to the household too

intake.question: Has the client requested the Imaging (attachments) backup from RedTail support?
intake.why: documents.csv is metadata only; without the Imaging backup no files can be migrated.

intake.question: Has the manual users list (id, name, email, username, Active/Disabled) been captured from Manage Database Users & Teams?
intake.why: The backup has no users table; added_by / user_id / attendee columns are unresolvable without it. See the Key Map for every column that needs it.
intake.default: Capture on the day the backup is taken

intake.question: Store advisors as a picklist field or as a User lookup?
intake.why: Picklist needs no user records; User lookup needs an active or inactive user per advisor.

intake.question: Migrate contact_memberships as Contact-Contact Relationships? Provide the reciprocal role map.
intake.why: Each relationship needs source role + inverse role ids; self-relationships error out.
intake.default: Yes — build the Reciprocal Role Map early

intake.question: Which types map to standard fields, and does everything else go to an Additional Details object?
intake.why: Standard: home/work/mobile phone, email 1/2, address type 1 → Billing, type 2 → Mailing/Shipping.
intake.default: Standard fields + all records into Additional Details

intake.question: Confirm custom fields for RedTail-only data: referred_by, client_termination_date, dob_reminder, death date, nickname, designation, pronunciation.
intake.why: Populated-% on the Schema tab shows which of these carry data worth a field.
intake.default: Create only where populated % is material

intake.question: Exclude records where deleted = true (and archived) everywhere?
intake.why: Standard rule; the Non-Deleted counts on this workbook already apply it.
